summary: Yimutian Inc. (Nasdaq: YMT) filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of two Nasdaq notifications on May 13, 2026: a deficiency notice for failing the minimum market value of listed securities (MVLS) of $50M for 30 consecutive trading days through May 6, 2026, and a determination letter to delist for non-compliance with the minimum market value of publicly held shares (MVPHS) of $15M. The company has 180 days (until Nov 9, 2026) to regain MVLS compliance and will appeal the delisting determination, staying proceedings. No specific transaction terms or prices are provided. What to watch: ability to regain listing standards or face delisting and potential OTC trading transition.
